objective: 为业务表单元数据增加系统设置配置入口和受保护 API。
non_goals: 改造现有业务表单为动态渲染
修改业务主表和既有业务逻辑
decisions: Reuse SystemService permission checks and system settings navigation.
Keep metadata API under platform system and use explicit SQL allowlists.
Use the existing page header, data table, form drawer and delivery-showcase visual language.
Expose sections, field properties, static options, conditional rules and published revisions in one admin view.
risks: New public write API requires owner review and a live database migration check.
First business consumer is intentionally deferred to a separate task.
